maddeler.e:
ترتجون (form VIII)
# تَرْتَجُونَ (tartajūna) /tar.ta.d͡ʒuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَجَى (irtajā)
# تُرْتَجَوْنَ (turtajawna) /tur.ta.d͡ʒaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَجَى (irtajā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
